ONCOGLOBAL KEY ACCOUNTS — Hospital Intelligence
TIER 1 — HIGH PRIORITY ACCOUNTS: 1. Tata Memorial Hospital (TMH), Mumbai: India's premier oncology center. 1500+ beds. Oncology-only. High decision-maker concentration. Key specialties: Hematology, Medical Oncology, Surgical Oncology. Formulary approval critical. 2. AIIMS New Delhi: Government apex institution. Strong KOL presence. Long procurement cycles. Focus on research collaborations and CME. 3. HCG Oncology Network: Pan-India oncology chain (30+ centers). Centralized formulary decision but local KOL influence matters. Strong in Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad. 4. RGCI (Rajiv Gandhi Cancer Institute), Delhi: Private specialty cancer center. Tier-1 KOLs. Strong in hematology and solid tumors. Fast adoption of new molecules. 5. Kidwai Memorial Institute, Bangalore: Government cancer center. Large patient volume. Government procurement. CME and research focus.
TIER 2 — IMPORTANT ACCOUNTS: - Apollo Hospitals (Pan-India): Large network, local formulary per hospital. Strong in Chennai, Hyderabad, Delhi. - Fortis Healthcare (Pan-India): Good oncology volumes in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Kolkata. - Manipal Hospitals (South India focus): Strong in Bangalore, Mangalore. KOL-driven decisions. - Narayana Health: Volume oncology. Affordable segment. Bangalore, Kolkata. - Max Healthcare (Delhi NCR): High-end private segment. Strong relationship-driven. - Medanta, Gurugram: Super-specialty. High-volume KOLs. International patient segment. - KEM Hospital, Mumbai: Government teaching hospital. Large resident influence.
VISIT STRATEGIES: - Teaching hospitals (AIIMS, KEM, TMH): Focus on senior faculty, HODs, and resident education - Private networks (Apollo, Fortis, HCG): Focus on individual oncologists, department heads - CME/round strategy at TMH/AIIMS: Pre-approval from medical education dept required

KEY HOSPITALS — Rep ke liye Quick Guide
TOP PRIORITY: 1. Tata Memorial (TMH), Mumbai: India ka best cancer hospital. Yahan decision makers bahut hain. Formulary mein aana bahut important hai — yahan approval baaki jagah bhi help karta hai. 2. AIIMS Delhi: Government ka top hospital. Yahan KOLs hain jo puri India ko influence karte hain. Research aur CME pe focus karo. 3. HCG Network: 30+ centers pan-India. Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad mein strong. Central formulary hoti hai — ek baar approval mila toh sabhi centers pe faayda. 4. RGCI, Delhi: Top private cancer center Delhi mein. Fast adopters hain — naya molecule jaldi try karte hain. 5. Kidwai, Bangalore: Bada government cancer center. Zyada patients, government procurement.
IMPORTANT ACCOUNTS: - Apollo: Har city mein hai, local formulary hoti hai. Chennai, Hyderabad, Delhi strongest. - Fortis: Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Kolkata mein acha volume. - Manipal: South India, especially Bangalore. KOL important hain. - Narayana Health: Affordable segment, bada volume. - Max Healthcare: Delhi NCR mein high-end patients. - Medanta: Super-specialty, international patients bhi.
VISIT TIPS: - Teaching hospitals (AIIMS, KEM, TMH): Senior doctors aur HOD pe focus karo - Private networks: Individual oncologists pe relationship build karo - CME karna hai AIIMS/TMH mein: Pehle medical education department se permission lo
